quranTranslation.text: Establish worship, pay the poor-due, and bow your heads with those who bow (in worship).

explanation.bs: „I obavljajte namaz i dajite zekat“ – davanje zekata izraženo glagolom آتَى.
explanation.en: “Establish worship, pay the poor-due” — the giving of zakat expressed with آتَى.

quranTranslation.text: So they routed them by Allah's leave and David slew Goliath; and Allah gave him the kingdom and wisdom, and taught him of that which He willeth. And if Allah had not repelled some men by others the earth would have been corrupted. But Allah is a Lord of Kindness to (His) creatures.

explanation.bs: Allah je Davudu dao vlast i mudrost.
explanation.en: Allah gave David kingship and wisdom.

quranTranslation.text: We have given thee seven of the oft-repeated (verses) and the great Qur'an.

explanation.bs: „Doista smo ti dali sedam ponavljanih i veličanstveni Kur'an“ – tefsir se razilazi: Fatiha, ili sedam dugih sura.
explanation.en: “We have given thee seven of the oft-repeated (verses) and the great Qur'an” — tafsir differs: al-Fātiḥa, or the seven long surahs.

quranTranslation.text: So, when he had withdrawn from them and that which they were worshipping beside Allah, We gave him Isaac and Jacob. Each of them We made a prophet.

explanation.bs: Ibrahimu smo darovali Ishaka i Jakuba – dar djece.
explanation.en: We gave Abraham Isaac and Jacob — the gift of children.

quranTranslation.text: Our Lord! Cause not our hearts to stray after Thou hast guided us, and bestow upon us mercy from Thy Presence. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Bestower.

explanation.bs: „I podari nam od Sebe milost“ – dova.
explanation.en: “And bestow upon us mercy from Thy Presence” — a supplication.

quranTranslation.text: He said: My Lord! Forgive me and bestow on me sovereignty such as shall not belong to any after me. Lo! Thou art the Bestower.

explanation.bs: Sulejman moli: „podari mi vlast“ – dar bez naknade.
explanation.en: Solomon asks: “bestow on me sovereignty” — a gift without return.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! We have given thee Abundance;

explanation.bs: „Mi smo ti, uistinu, dali Kevser“ – Allahov dar Poslaniku.
explanation.en: “Lo! We have given thee Abundance [al-Kawthar]” — Allah's gift to the Prophet.

quranTranslation.text: As for him who giveth and is dutiful (toward Allah)

explanation.bs: „A onaj ko daje i Allaha se boji“ – ljudsko davanje.
explanation.en: “As for him who giveth and is dutiful (toward Allah)” — human giving.

quranTranslation.text: He said: Our Lord is He Who gave unto everything its nature, then guided it aright.

explanation.bs: „Gospodar naš je Onaj koji je svemu što postoji dao njegov lik“ – Musaov odgovor faraonu.
explanation.en: “Our Lord is He Who gave unto everything its nature” — Moses' answer to Pharaoh.

quranTranslation.text: And they came with false blood on his shirt. He said: Nay, but your minds have beguiled you into something. (My course is) comely patience. And Allah it is Whose help is to be sought in that (predicament) which ye describe.

explanation.bs: Donijeli su košulju njegovu s lažnom krvlju – Jusufova braća.
explanation.en: They brought his shirt with false blood — Joseph's brothers.

quranTranslation.text: And speak not, concerning that which your own tongues qualify (as clean or unclean), the falsehood: "This is lawful, and this is forbidden," so that ye invent a lie against Allah. Lo! those who invent a lie against Allah will not succeed.

explanation.bs: „I ne govorite za ono što vaši jezici lažno opisuju: Ovo je dozvoljeno, a ovo zabranjeno.“
explanation.en: “And speak not, concerning that which your own tongues qualify, the falsehood: This is lawful, and this is forbidden.”

quranTranslation.text: Who doth greater wrong than he who inventeth a lie against Allah or denieth His revelations? Lo! the wrongdoers will not be successful.

explanation.bs: Ko je veći zalim od onoga ko o Allahu laž izmišlja?
explanation.en: Who is more unjust than one who invents a lie about Allah?

quranTranslation.text: Lo! they who spread the slander are a gang among you. Deem it not a bad thing for you; nay, it is good for you. Unto every man of them (will be paid) that which he hath earned of the sin; and as for him among them who had the greater share therein, his will be an awful doom.

explanation.bs: Oni koji su iznijeli klevetu – tefsir: kleveta protiv Aiše, majke vjernika.
explanation.en: Those who came with the slander — tafsir: the slander against ʿĀʾisha, mother of the believers.

quranTranslation.text: Is it a falsehood - gods beside Allah - that ye desire?

explanation.bs: „Zar izmišljotinu – božanstva mimo Allaha – hoćete?“ – Ibrahim: idoli kao izokrenuta istina.
explanation.en: “Is it a falsehood - gods beside Allah - that ye desire?” — Abraham: idols as truth turned about.

quranTranslation.text: Then why did those whom they had chosen for gods as a way of approach (unto Allah) not help them? Nay, but they did fail them utterly. And (all) that was their lie, and what they used to invent.

explanation.bs: To je bila njihova izmišljotina i ono što su izmišljali.
explanation.en: That was their falsehood and what they were inventing.

quranTranslation.text: That (is the command). And whoso magnifieth the sacred things of Allah, it will be well for him in the sight of his Lord. The cattle are lawful unto you save that which hath been told you. So shun the filth of idols, and shun lying speech,

explanation.bs: „I klonite se lažnog govora“ – قَوْلَ الزُّورِ.
explanation.en: “And shun lying speech” — قَوْلَ الزُّورِ.

quranTranslation.text: And those who will not witness vanity, but when they pass near senseless play, pass by with dignity.

explanation.bs: Oni koji ne svjedoče lažno – tefsir se razilazi: lažno svjedočenje, ili prisustvovanje skupovima laži i mnogoboštva.
explanation.en: “Those who will not witness vanity” — tafsir differs: false witness, or attending gatherings of falsehood and idolatry.

quranTranslation.text: Such of you as put away your wives (by saying they are as their mothers) - They are not their mothers; none are their mothers except those who gave them birth - they indeed utter an ill word and a lie. And lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

explanation.bs: Zihar: „oni doista govore ružne riječi i neistinu“.
explanation.en: Ẓihār: “they indeed utter an ill word and a lie”.

quranTranslation.text: And those who, when they do an evil thing or wrong themselves, remember Allah and implore forgiveness for their sins - Who forgiveth sins save Allah only? - and will not knowingly repeat (the wrong) they did.

explanation.bs: Traže oprost za grijehe svoje – a ko oprašta grijehe osim Allaha?
explanation.en: They seek forgiveness for their sins — and who can forgive sins except Allah?

quranTranslation.text: Say: O My slaves who have been prodigal to their own hurt! Despair not of the mercy of Allah, Who forgiveth all sins. Lo! He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.

explanation.bs: „Allah, doista, oprašta sve grijehe.“
explanation.en: “Allah, Who forgiveth all sins.”

quranTranslation.text: For what sin she was slain,

explanation.bs: „Zbog kojeg je grijeha ubijena?“ – živa zakopana djevojčica.
explanation.en: “For what sin she was slain” — the girl buried alive.

quranTranslation.text: They question thee about strong drink and games of chance. Say: In both is great sin, and (some) utility for men; but the sin of them is greater than their usefulness. And they ask thee what they ought to spend. Say: that which is superfluous. Thus Allah maketh plain to you (His) revelations, that haply ye may reflect.

explanation.bs: „U njima dvjema je veliki grijeh i koristi za ljude“ – vino i kocka.
explanation.en: “In both is great sin, and (some) utility for men” — wine and gambling.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Profane not Allah's monuments nor the Sacred Month nor the offerings nor the garlands, nor those repairing to the Sacred House, seeking the grace and pleasure of their Lord. But when ye have left the sacred territory, then go hunting (if ye will). And let not your hatred of a folk who (once) stopped your going to the inviolable place of worship seduce you to transgress; but help ye one another unto righteousness and pious duty. Help not one another unto sin and transgression, but keep your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is severe in punishment.

explanation.bs: „A u grijehu i nasilju ne sarađujte jedni s drugima.“
explanation.en: “Help not one another unto sin and transgression.”

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Shun much suspicion; for lo! some suspicion is a crime. And spy not, neither backbite one another. Would one of you love to eat the flesh of his dead brother? Ye abhor that (so abhor the other)! And keep your duty (to Allah). Lo! Allah is Relenting, Merciful.

explanation.bs: „Neke su sumnje, doista, grijeh.“
explanation.en: “Some suspicion is a crime [ithm, sin].”

quranTranslation.text: Establish worship at the two ends of the day and in some watches of the night. Lo! good deeds annul ill-deeds. This is reminder for the mindful.

explanation.bs: „Dobra djela, doista, otklanjaju loša djela.“
explanation.en: “Lo! good deeds annul ill-deeds.”

quranTranslation.text: Whoso bringeth a good deed will receive tenfold the like thereof, while whoso bringeth an ill-deed will be awarded but the like thereof; and they will not be wronged.

explanation.bs: Ko učini hrđavo djelo, bit će kažnjen samo prema njemu.
explanation.en: Whoever comes with an evil deed will not be recompensed except the like thereof.

quranTranslation.text: The good deed and the evil deed are not alike. Repel the evil deed with one which is better, then lo! he, between whom and thee there was enmity (will become) as though he was a bosom friend.

explanation.bs: „Nisu jednaki dobro djelo i loše djelo“ – حَسَنَة i سَيِّئَة jedno nasuprot drugom.
explanation.en: “The good deed and the evil deed are not alike” — حَسَنَة and سَيِّئَة set against each other.

quranTranslation.text: And Who, I ardently hope, will forgive me my sin on the Day of Judgment.

explanation.bs: Ibrahim: „I Onaj od kojeg se nadam da će mi na Sudnjem danu oprostiti moj grijeh.“
explanation.en: Abraham: “And Who, I ardently hope, will forgive me my sin on the Day of Judgment.”

quranTranslation.text: And whoso committeth a delinquency or crime, then throweth (the blame) thereof upon the innocent, hath burdened himself with falsehood and a flagrant crime.

explanation.bs: Ko učini prestup (خَطِيئَة) ili grijeh (إِثْم), pa ga svali na nevina – obje riječi jedna uz drugu.
explanation.en: Whoever earns an offence (خَطِيئَة) or a sin (إِثْم) and then blames it on an innocent — both words side by side.

quranTranslation.text: Allah tasketh not a soul beyond its scope. For it (is only) that which it hath earned, and against it (only) that which it hath deserved. Our Lord! Condemn us not if we forget, or miss the mark! Our Lord! Lay not on us such a burden as thou didst lay on those before us! Our Lord! Impose not on us that which we have not the strength to bear! Pardon us, absolve us and have mercy on us, Thou, our Protector, and give us victory over the disbelieving folk.

explanation.bs: „Gospodaru naš, ne kažnjavaj nas ako zaboravimo“ – zaborav koji nije namjeran.
explanation.en: “Our Lord! Condemn us not if we forget” — forgetting that is not deliberate.

quranTranslation.text: He said: Didst thou see, when we took refuge on the rock, and I forgot the fish - and none but Satan caused me to forget to mention it - it took its way into the waters by a marvel.

explanation.bs: Musaov mladić: „…zaboravio sam ribu“ – obični zaborav, koji mladić pripisuje šejtanu.
explanation.en: Moses' servant: “I forgot the fish” — ordinary forgetting, which he ascribes to Satan.

quranTranslation.text: The hypocrites, both men and women, proceed one from another. They enjoin the wrong, and they forbid the right, and they withhold their hands (from spending for the cause of Allah). They forget Allah, so He hath forgotten them. Lo! the hypocrites, they are the transgressors.

explanation.bs: „Zaboravili su Allaha, pa je On zaboravio njih“ – ar-Rāġib: kod Allaha znači da ih je ostavio, kao kaznu za ono što su oni ostavili.
explanation.en: “They forget Allah, so He hath forgotten them” — ar-Rāġib: of Allah it means He left them, in return for what they left.

quranTranslation.text: And do thou (O Muhammad) remember thy Lord within thyself humbly and with awe, below thy breath, at morn and evening. And be not thou of the neglectful.

explanation.bs: „I ne budi među nemarnima“ – nemar kao stanje protiv kojeg se upozorava.
explanation.en: “And be not thou of the neglectful” — heedlessness as a state to guard against.

quranTranslation.text: Then, even after that, your hearts were hardened and became as rocks, or worse than rocks, for hardness. For indeed there are rocks from out which rivers gush, and indeed there are rocks which split asunder so that water floweth from them. And indeed there are rocks which fall down for the fear of Allah. Allah is not unaware of what ye do.

explanation.bs: „A Allah nije nemaran spram onoga što radite“ – Allah zna sve što ljudi čine.
explanation.en: “Allah is not unaware of what ye do” — Allah knows all that people do.

quranTranslation.text: He said: Lo! in truth it saddens me that ye should take him with you, and I fear less the wolf devour him while ye are heedless of him.

explanation.bs: Jakub: „…bojim se da će ga vuk pojesti dok vi na njega ne pazite“ – nepažnja, a ne zaborav.
explanation.en: Jacob fears a wolf may devour him “while ye are heedless of him” — inattention, not forgetting.

quranTranslation.text: Muhammad is but a messenger, messengers (the like of whom) have passed away before him. Will it be that, when he dieth or is slain, ye will turn back on your heels? He who turneth back on his heels doth no hurt to Allah, and Allah will reward the thankful.

explanation.bs: „Muhammed nije ništa drugo nego poslanik“ – vjerovjesnik kao poslanik.
explanation.en: “Muhammad is but a messenger” — a prophet as messenger.

quranTranslation.text: (The messengers) said: O Lot! Lo! we are messengers of thy Lord; they shall not reach thee. So travel with thy people in a part of the night, and let not one of you turn round - (all) save thy wife. Lo! that which smiteth them will smite her (also). Lo! their tryst is (for) the morning. Is not the morning nigh?

explanation.bs: Meleki Lutu: „Lute, mi smo izaslanici (رُسُل) tvoga Gospodara“ – meleki kao poslanici.
explanation.en: The angels to Lot: “O Lot! Lo! we are messengers (رُسُل) of thy Lord” — angels as messengers.

quranTranslation.text: Never sent We a messenger or a prophet before thee but when He recited (the message) Satan proposed (opposition) in respect of that which he recited thereof. But Allah abolisheth that which Satan proposeth. Then Allah establisheth His revelations. Allah is Knower, Wise;

explanation.bs: „Nismo prije tebe poslali nijednog poslanika ni vjerovjesnika…“ – dvije riječi navedene odvojeno.
explanation.en: “Never sent We a messenger or a prophet before thee…” — the two words named apart.

quranTranslation.text: And make mention in the Scripture of Moses. Lo! he was chosen, and he was a messenger (of Allah), a prophet.

explanation.bs: „On je doista bio izabran, i bio je poslanik, vjerovjesnik“ – Musa nazvan i jednim i drugim imenom.
explanation.en: “Lo! he was chosen, and he was a messenger (of Allah), a prophet” — Moses called by both names.

quranTranslation.text: Muhammad is not the father of any man among you, but he is the messenger of Allah and the Seal of the Prophets; and Allah is ever Aware of all things.

explanation.bs: „…nego Allahov Poslanik i pečat vjerovjesnika“ – ar-Rāġib: njime je vjerovjesništvo dovršeno.
explanation.en: “…but he is the messenger of Allah and the Seal of the Prophets” — ar-Rāġib: with him prophethood was completed.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! those of mankind who have the best claim to Abraham are those who followed him, and this Prophet and those who believe (with him); and Allah is the Protecting Guardian of the believers.

explanation.bs: „Ibrahimu su od ljudi najpreči oni koji su ga slijedili, i ovaj Vjerovjesnik, i oni koji vjeruju.“
explanation.en: “Lo! those of mankind who have the best claim to Abraham are those who followed him, and this Prophet and those who believe.”

quranTranslation.text: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the Daybreak

explanation.bs: „Reci: ‚Utječem se Gospodaru svitanja‘“ – ar-Rāġib navodi formulu ‚qul aʿūḏu bi-rabbi‘.
explanation.en: “Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the Daybreak” — ar-Rāġib cites the formula ‘qul aʿūḏu bi-rabbi’.

quranTranslation.text: She said: Lo! I seek refuge in the Beneficent One from thee, if thou art Allah-fearing.

explanation.bs: „Rekla je: ‚Ja se Svemilosnom utječem od tebe, ako si bogobojazan‘“ – Merjem pred melekom koji joj je došao u liku čovjeka; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “She said: Lo! I seek refuge in the Beneficent One from thee, if thou art Allah-fearing” — Mary before the angel who came to her in the form of a man; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And indeed (O Muhammad) individuals of humankind used to invoke the protection of individuals of the jinn, so that they increased them in revolt against Allah);

explanation.bs: „A bilo je ljudi koji su zaštitu tražili kod nekih džina, pa su ovi samo uvećali njihovu pobunu“ – jedino mjesto gdje se ne utječe Allahu.
explanation.en: “… individuals of humankind used to invoke the protection of individuals of the jinn, so that they increased them in revolt against Allah” — the one place where refuge is not sought with Allah.

quranTranslation.text: And hold fast, all of you together, to the cable of Allah, and do not separate. And remember Allah's favour unto you: How ye were enemies and He made friendship between your hearts so that ye became as brothers by His grace; and (how) ye were upon the brink of an abyss of fire, and He did save you from it. Thus Allah maketh clear His revelations unto you, that haply ye may be guided,

explanation.bs: „I svi se čvrsto držite Allahova užeta i ne razjedinjujte se …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And hold fast, all of you together, to the cable of Allah, and do not separate” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: How can ye disbelieve, when it is ye unto whom Allah's revelations are recited, and His messenger is in your midst? He who holdeth fast to Allah, he indeed is guided unto a right path.

explanation.bs: „… a ko se čvrsto drži Allaha, taj je upućen na pravi put“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ‚ko se drži Allaha‘.
explanation.en: “He who holdeth fast to Allah, he indeed is guided unto a right path” — ar-Rāġib cites ‘who holds fast to Allah’.

quranTranslation.text: And to the three also (did He turn in mercy) who were left behind, when the earth, vast as it is, was straitened for them, and their own souls were straitened for them till they bethought them that there is no refuge from Allah save toward Him. Then turned He unto them in mercy that they (too) might turn (repentant unto Him). Lo! Allah! He is the Relenting, the Merciful.

explanation.bs: „… i shvatili su da nema pribježišta od Allaha osim kod Njega …“ – trojica koji su izostali iz pohoda; bijeg od Allaha vodi samo Njemu.
explanation.en: The three who stayed behind came to see that there is no haven from Allah except in Him — flight from Allah leads only to Him.

gloss.en: a haven, a place to flee to

quranTranslation.text: Answer the call of your Lord before there cometh unto you from Allah a Day which there is no averting. Ye have no refuge on that Day, nor have a ye any (power of) refusal.

explanation.bs: „… tog Dana nećete imati pribježišta …“ – na Sudnjem danu nema mjesta u koje bi se pobjeglo.
explanation.en: On that Day there will be no haven to flee to — on the Day of Judgement there is no place of escape.

gloss.en: a haven, a place to flee to

quranTranslation.text: The day when (all) mankind stand before the Lord of the Worlds?

explanation.bs: „Dana kad će ljudi stajati pred Gospodarom svjetova“ – ovdje je običan glagol ‚stajati‘ (yaqūmu), a ne pasiv ‚biti postavljen‘ kao u 6:30.
explanation.en: “The day when (all) mankind stand before the Lord of the Worlds?” — here the plain verb ‘stand’ (yaqūmu) is used, not the passive ‘are made to stand’ of 6:30.

quranTranslation.text: Be guardians of your prayers, and of the midmost prayer, and stand up with devotion to Allah.

explanation.bs: „Brižno čuvajte namaze, a osobito srednji, i stanite Allahu predani“ – stajanje po izboru, u ibadetu.
explanation.en: “Be guardians of your prayers, and of the midmost prayer, and stand up with devotion to Allah” — standing by choice, in worship.

quranTranslation.text: The lightning almost snatcheth away their sight from them. As often as it flasheth forth for them they walk therein, and when it darkeneth against them they stand still. If Allah willed, He could destroy their hearing and their sight. Lo! Allah is able to do all things.

explanation.bs: „… kad im zasvijetli, idu u njemu, a kad se nad njima smrači, zastanu …“ – ovdje qāma znači stati na mjestu, suprotno hodanju.
explanation.en: “As often as it flasheth forth for them they walk therein, and when it darkeneth against them they stand still” — here qāma means stopping in place, the opposite of walking.

quranTranslation.text: And stop them, for they must be questioned.

explanation.bs: „I zaustavite ih, oni će, zaista, biti pitani“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And stop them, for they must be questioned” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: If thou couldst see when they are set before their Lord! He will say: Is not this real? They will say: Yea, verily, by our Lord! He will say: Taste now the retribution for that ye used to disbelieve.

explanation.bs: „A kad bi samo vidio kad budu postavljeni pred svoga Gospodara …“ – nisu stali sami, nego su postavljeni; usporedi 83:6, gdje ljudi stoje.
explanation.en: “If thou couldst see when they are set before their Lord!” — they did not stand of themselves, they were set there; compare 83:6, where people stand.

quranTranslation.text: And He it is Who hath given independence to the two seas (though they meet); one palatable, sweet, and the other saltish, bitter; and hath set a bar and a forbidding ban between them.

explanation.bs: „I On je Taj Koji je pustio dva mora jedno uz drugo – jedno pitko, slatko, a drugo slano, gorko …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ove riječi.
explanation.en: “And He it is Who hath given independence to the two seas (though they meet); one palatable, sweet, and the other saltish, bitter” — ar-Rāġib cites these words.

quranTranslation.text: And placed therein high mountains and given you to drink sweet water therein?

explanation.bs: „… i dali vam da pijete slatku vodu“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet; blagodat, kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “… and given you to drink sweet water” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah; a favour, as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: And the two seas are not alike: this, fresh, sweet, good to drink, this (other) bitter, salt. And from them both ye eat fresh meat and derive the ornament that ye wear. And thou seest the ship cleaving them with its prow that ye may seek of His bounty, and that haply ye may give thanks.

explanation.bs: „Ta dva mora se ne izjednačavaju: iz jednog se lako pije, pitko je i slatko, a drugo je slano i gorko …“ – slano more naspram pitkog.
explanation.en: “And the two seas are not alike: this, fresh, sweet, good to drink, this (other) bitter, salt” — the salt sea set against the fresh.

quranTranslation.text: If We willed We verily could make it bitter. Why then, give ye not thanks?

explanation.bs: „Da smo htjeli, pretvorili bismo je u gorku vodu – pa zašto onda ne zahvaljujete?“ – voda za piće koja bi mogla postati gorka; Allahova volja, kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “If We willed We verily could make it bitter. Why then, give ye not thanks?” — drinking water that could be made bitter; Allah's will, as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: Yet he hath led astray of you a great multitude. Had ye then no sense?

explanation.bs: „A on je već odveo s puta silno mnoštvo od vas – zar niste razumjeli?“ – o šejtanu; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Yet he hath led astray of you a great multitude. Had ye then no sense?” — of Satan; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: It was never Allah's (part) that He should send a folk astray after He had guided them until He had made clear unto them what they should avoid. Lo! Allah is Aware of all things.

explanation.bs: „Nije Allahovo da odvede s puta narod pošto ga je uputio, dok im jasno ne pokaže od čega se trebaju sustezati …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet: Allah ne odvodi s puta one koje je uputio, kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “It was never Allah's (part) that He should send a folk astray after He had guided them until He had made clear unto them what they should avoid” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah: Allah does not lead astray those He has guided, as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: Thus we misled you. Lo! we were (ourselves) astray.

explanation.bs: „Pa smo vas zaveli – i mi smo bili u zabludi“ – vođe ne poriču, ali svoje zavođenje vežu uz vlastitu zabludu.
explanation.en: “Thus we misled you. Lo! we were (ourselves) astray” — the leaders do not deny it, but tie their misleading to their own error.

gloss.en: to lure into error, to mislead
